title: Tomato & mozzarella salad with red onion (+ avocado, optional)
desc: Cherry tomatoes, mozzarella and red onion in a sharp oregano-vinegar dressing, avocado optional.
trouble: Dress it only right before eating; salt pulls the tomato juice out.
Let it sit in the dressing 5 minutes first.

steps.t: Put the halved cherry tomatoes, the mozzarella bites and the sliced red onion in a bowl.
steps.w: Everything bite-sized so each forkful gets all three.
steps.m: Thick onion rings — slice it thin.
steps.img: bowl of halved cherry tomatoes mozzarella balls and thin red onion slices

steps.t: Make the sauce for this salad: whisk the oil, vinegar, oregano, salt and pepper with a fork for 30 seconds until cloudy, pour it over and toss. Let it sit 5 minutes.
steps.w: The vinegar softens the onion and pulls the tomato juice into the dressing.
steps.m: Pouring oil and vinegar on separately — they never mix.
steps.img: oregano vinegar dressing whisked with a fork in a small bowl

steps.t: Add the avocado cubes on top of that bowl.
steps.w: Avocado last so it stays green and whole.
steps.m: Tossing it in — it turns to mush.
steps.img: avocado cubes on a tomato mozzarella salad

title: Caprese toast (rye or sourdough)
desc: Toasted bread with sliced tomato, mozzarella and basil, finished with a balsamic-oil drizzle.
trouble: Toast it well and drizzle just before eating.

steps.t: Toast the bread: the rye, the sourdough, about 3 minutes until crisp.
steps.w: Crisp toast holds the wet tomato.
steps.img: toasted rye and sourdough slices on a plate

steps.t: Lay tomato and mozzarella slices on the toast, overlapping, and salt the tomatoes. Add the basil leaves.
steps.w: Salt brings out the tomato flavour.
steps.img: tomato and mozzarella slices layered on toast with basil leaves

steps.t: Make the sauce: whisk the oil and balsamic with a fork for 20 seconds until glossy and drizzle it over the tomatoes; finish with pepper.
steps.w: Oil + a little vinegar turns the tomato juice into a dressing.
steps.m: Too much balsamic — 1 tsp is enough.
steps.img: balsamic oil drizzled over caprese toast

title: Chopped-egg toast (avocado or egg-mayo)
desc: Boiled eggs chopped warm onto toast. The goes on smashed avocado; the is stirred with mayo and mustard (egg salad on bread).
left: The egg-mayo keeps 1 day in the fridge.
trouble: 8 minutes, then straight into cold water.

steps.t: Boil the eggs 8 minutes, then 2 minutes in cold water. Peel and chop them roughly with a fork. Toast the bread.
steps.w: 8 minutes = set yolk that is still soft in the middle.
steps.img: chopped boiled eggs in a bowl next to toasted rye bread

steps.t: Mash the avocado with the lemon juice and a pinch of salt, spread it on the toast and pile half the egg on top.
steps.w: Lemon keeps the avocado green.
steps.c: Green layer, yellow egg on top.
steps.img: a slice of rye toast spread thickly with green smashed avocado, topped with a heap of roughly chopped hard-boiled egg pieces (white and yellow chunks, no fried egg, no whole egg)

steps.t: Stir that half of the egg with the mayonnaise, mustard, salt and pepper and spread it on the rye toast.
steps.w: Egg salad — creamy without avocado.
steps.img: a slice of rye toast topped with creamy pale-yellow egg salad: chopped hard-boiled egg mixed with mayonnaise and mustard (no avocado, no fried egg)

steps.t: Finish both with black pepper and the chilli flakes.
steps.img: two open toasts side by side topped with chopped hard-boiled egg pieces, one on green avocado, one as creamy egg salad, sprinkled with black pepper and red chilli flakes (no fried eggs)

title: Chia pudding with strawberries
desc: Chia seeds soaked overnight in milk, topped with chopped strawberries (2 boiled eggs on the side). Five minutes the night before.
left: Keeps 3 days in the fridge, add the fruit on the day.
trouble: Stir again after 5 minutes, before it goes in the fridge.
Add 1 tbsp more chia and wait 15 minutes.

steps.t: Stir the chia into the milk in a bowl. Wait 5 minutes, stir again to break the lumps, cover and put it in the fridge overnight (at least 2 hours).
steps.w: Chia swells and turns the milk into a pudding; the second stir stops clumps.
steps.m: Skipping the second stir — you get a dry lump at the bottom.
steps.img: chia seeds stirred into milk in a bowl

steps.t: Boil 2 eggs for 8 minutes, cool 2 minutes in cold water, peel and halve them for the side of that bowl.
steps.w: Chia alone is too little protein for the breakfast.
steps.img: two halved boiled eggs next to a chia pudding bowl

steps.t: Spoon into two bowls and top with the chopped strawberries.
steps.w: The fruit brings the sweetness — no sugar needed.
steps.img: chia pudding bowl topped with chopped strawberries

title: Chia pudding with kiwi (Greek yogurt or eggs)
desc: Overnight chia pudding with fresh kiwi; a spoon of Greek yogurt or 2 boiled eggs on the side.
left: Keeps 3 days in the fridge, add the fruit on the day.

steps.t: Stir the chia into the milk. Wait 5 minutes, stir again, cover and leave in the fridge overnight (at least 2 hours).
steps.w: The second stir stops clumps.
steps.img: chia seeds soaking in milk in a bowl

steps.t: Boil 2 eggs for 8 minutes, cool 2 minutes in cold water, peel and halve them for the side of that bowl.
steps.w: Chia alone is too little protein for the breakfast.
steps.img: two halved boiled eggs next to a chia pudding bowl

steps.t: Spoon into two bowls and top with the kiwi cubes.
steps.img: chia pudding with kiwi cubes

steps.t: Add the Greek yogurt to the side of that bowl.
steps.w: Extra protein for the.
steps.img: chia pudding with kiwi and a spoon of thick yogurt

title: Smoky paprika chicken with roast carrots & rice (or brown rice)
desc: Spice-rubbed chicken breast from the pan, air-fried carrots, rice, and a lemon-butter pan sauce.
trouble: Medium heat, not high — paprika scorches fast.
Cut them thinner or give them 4 more minutes.

steps.t: Rice: the brown rice in plenty of salted boiling water for 25 minutes, then drain. The basmati in 150 ml water, lid on, low heat 12 minutes.
steps.w: Brown rice needs twice as long — start it first.
steps.c: Tender grains, no water left in the pot.
steps.img: two small pots of white and brown rice

steps.t: Mix the paprikas, garlic powder, cumin, salt and pepper. Toss the carrots with 1 tbsp oil and a third of the spice; air-fry 190 °C for 18 minutes.
steps.img: spiced carrot sticks in an air fryer basket

steps.t: Rub the chicken with the rest of the spice and 1 tbsp oil; fry on medium heat 6 minutes a side. Put it on a plate to rest.
steps.w: Medium heat keeps the paprika red, not black.
steps.img: paprika rubbed chicken breasts frying in a pan

steps.t: Make the sauce in the chicken pan: add the butter, the lemon juice and 3 tbsp water, scrape up the brown spice bits and bubble 1 minute until it coats a spoon. Pour it over the sliced chicken and carrots.
steps.w: The spice crust in the pan is the flavour of the sauce.
steps.c: Glossy red-orange, coats the back of a spoon.
steps.img: a frying pan with a thin glossy red-orange pan sauce of melted butter, lemon juice and paprika spice bits, a wooden spatula scraping the brown bits; thin and shiny, not a cheese sauce

title: Beef kofta with charred carrots & sour onion sauce (+ hummus, optional)
desc: Spiced beef mince kofta and air-fried carrots with a sharp red-onion vinegar pan sauce; the other plate goes on hummus.
trouble: Squeeze the grated onion dry and knead the mince 1 minute.
One more spoon of water and 30 seconds more.

steps.t: Toss the carrots with 1 tbsp oil and a pinch of salt; air-fry 200 °C for 18 minutes until charred at the edges.
steps.img: halved carrots charred in an air fryer basket

steps.t: Knead the mince with the grated onion, garlic, cumin, paprika, half the parsley, salt and pepper for 1 minute. Shape 6 long kofta (on skewers if you have them).
steps.w: Kneading makes the mince stick together.
steps.img: six long spiced mince kofta shaped on a board

steps.t: Fry the kofta in 1 tbsp oil on medium-high heat for 8 minutes, turning every 2 minutes. Take them out.
steps.m: Turning too early — wait for the crust.
steps.img: beef kofta browning in a pan

steps.t: Make the sauce in the kofta pan: add the red onion, the vinegar and 3 tbsp water, scrape up the brown bits and bubble 2 minutes until the onion is soft and the sauce is glossy. Spoon it over the kofta and carrots, scatter the rest of the parsley.
steps.w: Sour onion-vinegar cuts the rich beef.
steps.c: Pink glossy onions, sauce coats a spoon.
steps.m: Leaving the brown bits in the pan.
steps.img: red onion vinegar sauce bubbling in a pan with brown bits

steps.t: Spread the hummus on that plate and put the kofta and carrots on top.
steps.img: kofta and charred carrots on a plate of hummus

title: Smoked salmon & rocket toast (butter-mustard or cream cheese)
desc: Toast with smoked salmon, rocket, lemon and pepper. Counts as a fish meal.

steps.t: Toast the bread: the rye, the sourdough, about 3 minutes. Spread the with butter and mustard, the with the cream cheese.
steps.img: toast spread with butter and mustard and toast with cream cheese

steps.t: Top with the rocket and the smoked salmon in loose folds, then a squeeze of lemon and black pepper.
steps.w: Lemon cuts the smoky fat.
steps.img: smoked salmon and rocket on toast with black pepper
